scope: Invented DOCX text-box source contexts, equivalent alternatives, isolated parser and upload contracts. No private case input or inference.
preserved: existing uploads and original byte streams
historical profiles, passage IDs and exact evidence versions
quotation ranges, drafts and review history
all CI allocations, workers, cases and deadlines
limits: Only standalone DrawingML/VML text boxes; exact XML contexts do not establish visual order, page placement, clipping, overflow or field values.
Equivalent modern/fallback box structure is admitted once; different text, attributes, references or table content fails closed.
Unsupported wrappers, nested or chained boxes fail without partial successful passages.
Inline/cell content controls, revision/custom run wrappers and unrendered symbol-font tokens in boxes fail visibly rather than silently omitting a condition.
Normalization is in memory only; originals remain primary visual evidence.
No migration, re-extraction, private inference or human review.
Rendering, numbering, group layouts, scans, legacy and representative legal completeness remain unqualified.
